name: case_lookup_creation
description: Reuse or create a case for a verified member's email thread, or update case facts (last intent, validated forms on file)

thread_key.description: Normalized email subject identifying the case's thread

forms_on_file.description: form_id -> status ('valid' or any other value, e.g. 'incomplete'). Persisted as 'valid' or 'received_not_valid'; a 'valid' entry is never reverted by a later non-valid update
